title: BLANK & BLANK is BLANK, not an empty string

source.quote: A BLANK argument is an empty string. If both arguments are BLANK , the result is BLANK
source.supports: CONCATENATE of two BLANKs is BLANK

source.quote: CONCATENATE ( Text1, Text2 ) gives the same result as Text1 & Text2
source.supports: the & operator gives what CONCATENATE gives

source.quote: a blank value is always converted to 0 or to an empty string, depending on the data type requested by the expression
source.supports: the general rule, which read alone would give an empty string

derivation: CONCATENATE of two BLANK arguments is BLANK, and & gives the same result as CONCATENATE, so BLANK () & BLANK () is BLANK.
alternative: Each BLANK is converted to an empty string, as SQLBI's general rule says, and the result is the empty string "" (a string, not BLANK).
notes: The column's type is not asserted: no source says what type this result has.
